rejected.reason: The group links three disparate events without coherent shared context or substantive narrative overlap: Baoyu being sent to the clan school (n-81-7), Miaoyu and Baoyu hearing Daiyu play the zither where a string breaks (n-87-4), and Fengjie advising how to handle Baoyu's lost jade (n-94-7). The rationale creates an artificial, highly generalized umbrella topic ('external pressure, fate omen, and search strategy') that fails to represent a legitimate common event, thread, or cohesive narrative unit among the children.
